banPlayer.liveVerification: live 2026-10-14 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: online: reason line then kick; rejoin refused 0.65 s after the join request, before spawn; 4-minute ban lifted by the connector at expiresAt, rejoin without unban
banPlayer.reason: Writes the SteamID64 to BannedUsers.ini plus takaro-bans.json (reason, expiresAt, Takaro's name). The connector enforces it: a banned id is kicked as soon as its PlayerController exists (1 Hz poll), before the prisoner spawns. expiresAt is lifted by the connector (Takaro sends no unban), also after downtime.

executeConsoleCommand.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: command_not_allowed refusal; 'announce' with nobody online; 'location'/'ListPlayers' run through the online admin (admin log line, output in the admin's chat)
executeConsoleCommand.reason: COMMAND_ALLOWLIST gate. SCUM runs admin commands only through a player controller (the only IAdminCommandExecutor), so allowlisted verbs go through an online admin's PlayerRpcChannel:Chat_Server_ProcessAdminCommand (output only in that admin's chat) and fail with no_executor when no admin is online. announce and listplayers are implemented natively and work with nobody online. A server-owned executor is not possible from UE4SS Lua: SCUM ignores a server-spawned controller (and crashed ~60 s later), and running through a non-admin's channel would act in that player's name.

getMapInfo.reason: Protocol 0 only (Takaro does not ask for map info on protocol 1, where the connector declares the map capability instead: Dimension the_island, source none, bounds from the server's ConZWorldSettings.WorldBounds); a disabled map DTO keeps validation happy.
getMapInfo.responseShape: { enabled: false, mapBlockSize: 0, maxZoom: 0, mapSizeX: 0, mapSizeY: 0, mapSizeZ: 0 }

getMapTile.reason: The server has no map art to render tiles from; on protocol 1 the map Dimension is source none and the operator uploads the in-game map image in Takaro.

getPlayer.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: getPlayer frame for a SteamID64 player with ip
getPlayer.reason: ConZPlayerController:GetUserId/GetUserProfileName; offline players answer the last-known record.
getPlayer.responseShape: IGamePlayer { gameId, name, steamId, platformId, ip?, ping? }

getPlayerInventory.liveVerification: live 2026-10-14 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: 3 client comparisons: worn clothes, backpack/holster contents, item in hands, stacks 13x/20x/4x, durability 50%/75%/99%; Takaro history + player-inventory-changed match
getPlayerInventory.reason: SCUM's inventory is not reflected; the prisoner's AActor.Children tree holds every carried item (worn, hands, container contents, nested). amount = UStackableItemComponent._repQuantity for stacks, quality = GetHealth/GetMaxHealth in whole percent. A failed read answers an error, never [] (Takaro would record removals). Rounds loaded in a weapon or magazine are not items and are not listed.
getPlayerInventory.responseShape: IItemDTO[] { code, name, amount, quality } (bare array; quality = durability %)

getPlayerLocation.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: x/y/z frames; values match the post-teleport position read in game
getPlayerLocation.reason: Prisoner K2_GetActorLocation; offline or dead players answer the last position seen.
getPlayerLocation.responseShape: { x, y, z } (SCUM world units, cm)

getPlayers.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: [] with nobody online, then the test player with steamId/platformId steam:<id>/ip 127.0.0.1/ping
getPlayers.reason: FindAllOf(ConZPlayerController) with a SteamID64; IP from the login log, ping = PlayerState.Ping * 4.

giveItem.liveVerification: live 2026-10-14 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: 2 Apples into shirt+pants pockets, Katana into holster 1, 5 x .50 AE merged into one stack (5x -> 10x), full pockets -> Apple into empty hands; shop deliveries in the inventory (client screenshots)
giveItem.reason: Loads the Item primary asset by code, spawns it at the player; clothes go onto a free body slot (Server_CharacterInventoryComponent_EquipClothes), quality (1-100) sets the durability; else the controller's InventoryUserComponent:Server_CharacterInventoryComponent_PickupItem(prisoner inventory, item) = the player's own pickup; read back by Owner chain (stackables merge: stack quantity 0 / destroyed = delivered). Items that fit nowhere: the first goes into empty hands, the rest stays at the player's feet; rawResult reports the split.

kickPlayer.liveVerification: live 2026-10-14 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: reason line 'You are kicked: …' in the client chat, KickPlayer 2 s later, kick dialog
kickPlayer.reason: The reason is sent to the player's chat first (SCUM's kick screen has no reason text), then AConZGameMode:KickPlayer(controller, reason) 2 s later; Takaro gets the answer after the kick.

listBans.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: Takaro syncBans created a ban from a BannedUsers.ini entry
listBans.reason: BannedUsers.ini plus the connector's ban store; reason always a string (Takaro BanDTO requires it).

listEntities.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: 65 entities in Takaro entitySearch (Bear hostile, Deer neutral, Drifter Lvl 1 hostile)
listEntities.reason: Zombie, ArmedNPC and Animal primary assets. Animals use SpeciesName; zombies and NPCs have no engine display name, so their names are humanized from the asset code (Zombie Civilian, Drifter Lvl 1).

listItems.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: 2854 items in Takaro itemSearch with human names (TEC01 M9, M9 Magazine, Tooth Necklace)
listItems.reason: All 'Item' primary assets; names from the CDO GetInteractableName, descriptions from GetDescription. Built once on the game thread under a 4 ms/tick budget (~3.5 min, single loads up to ~1 s) and cached per engine build in items-cache.json; 26 codes without an engine name get a humanized one.

listLocations.reason: SCUM exposes no named location registry on the server; the connector answers [] and does not declare locations.list on protocol 1.

sendMessage.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: directed and global lines seen in the client chat as 'Takaro: ...'
sendMessage.reason: MiscStatics:BroadcastChatLine (global) and MiscStatics:SendChatLineToPlayer (directed), EChatType ServerMessage; senderNameOverride becomes a 'Name: ' prefix.

shutdown.reason: Gated by ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE_COMMANDS; KismetSystemLibrary:QuitGame after the response is sent.

testReachability.reason: Checks the live world (ConZGameMode and MiscStatics found).

unbanPlayer.liveVerification: live 2026-10-14 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: unban of a ban SCUM had loaded at server start: rejoin worked 1 min later, no restart
unbanPlayer.reason: Removes the SteamID64 from BannedUsers.ini and the ban store at once; works offline. For a ban that was in the file at server start #UnbanPlayer also runs through the next online admin.

architecture: in-process UE4SS mod inside SCUMServer.exe: Lua protocol + game adapter (Scripts/), C++ WinHTTP WebSocket transport (dlls/main.dll); outbound WSS only, no sidecar, no inbound port
connector: Takaro SCUM native connector (UE4SS mod TakaroSCUM)

chat-message.liveVerification: live 2026-10-14 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: LOCAL line -> channel friends, GLOBAL line -> global
chat-message.reason: Hook on PlayerRpcChannel:Chat_Server_BroadcastChatMessage (Global/Admin -> global, Local (proximity) -> friends, Squad -> team); the chat log is a fallback, deduplicated. #admin commands are not chat. Server messages have no player, so no echo.

entity-killed.liveVerification: live 2026-10-14 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: spawned zombies killed with a Katana (melee) and a DEagle 50 (firearm) -> entity 'Zombie Civilian Skinny Male', weapon 'Katana' / 'DEagle 50'
entity-killed.payloadShape: { player: IGamePlayer, entity: string, weapon: string }
entity-killed.reason: Attack-RPC hooks (projectile damage, melee capsule hit, base-damage, explosive) record which player attacked; a liveness scan of non-player AConZCharacters (2 s, 0.5 s after an attack) sees the death; the weapon is the NPC's _weaponClassLastHitBy, both named from the catalogues. No attacker within 300 m / 15 s or no weapon recorded = no event (despawned animals are never credited).

log.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: admin log line 'Command: location' as a log gameEvent (wire only; Takaro has no log search)

player-connected.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: the test player with steamId, platformId steam:<id>, ip; Takaro player-connected record
player-connected.reason: SCUM login log line (has IP) plus getPlayers reconciliation; dedup by online state (~1 s log latency). A Lua reload marks players already online silently (no duplicate, live 2026-10-14). A banned login is refused, not announced.

player-death.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: fall death after a +300 m teleport: player-death with position; Takaro record
player-death.payloadShape: { player: IGamePlayer, attacker?: IGamePlayer, position?: { x, y, z } }
player-death.reason: AConZCharacter:IsAlive polled at 1 Hz on the existing prisoner (a kick/logout without a prisoner is not a death); PvP kills from the kill log add the attacker (kill-log path unit-tested, not yet seen live: needs a second player).

player-disconnected.liveVerification: live 2026-10-13 on SCUM 1.3.4.2 through Takaro: after kick and ban kick; Takaro record
player-disconnected.reason: SCUM login log 'logged out' line (partial: log-derived, ~1 s latency).
